recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. issue_request: FHIR-37758 was a Published Clinical Genomics R5 change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to add terminology support for GenomicStudy.analysis.changeType; the final resolution requested a new example CodeSystem and ValueSet with DNA, RNA, AA, CHR, and CNV change-type codes.
initial_application: Commit e9225d72a12b first added DNA/RNA/amino-acid examples to the GenomicStudy.analysis.changeType definition. The genomicStudy_terminologyBinding branch then added the genomicstudy-changetype CodeSystem, the matching ValueSet, and an example binding on GenomicStudy.analysis.changeType in f74554c0ff63, 40b99a801c28, and ff3c60841406, merged by PR #2116 in ff7c5cbbec68.
additional_context: The retained GenomicStudy source and R5 publication artifacts still expose the requested binding and terminology. Current source/fhir.ini no longer includes GenomicStudy in active resource/build-scope entries after the 2025 remove-additional-resources change, and FHIR-37759 from the same terminology-binding family is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing retained GenomicStudy source would not be a current-build correction, and the R5 request is already represented in retained source and the R5 publication surface.
